'fiT.3iT.890(31) 25.03.2014 ['IWT II -~ 3(ii) ] 3 MINISTRY OF MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES NOTIFICA TlON New Delhi, the 23rd January, 2015 S.O. 226 (E).-In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3 of the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006 (27 of 2006) read with rule 3 of the National Board for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Rules, 2006 and in supersession of the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises number S.O. 1375 (E), dated the 2ih May, 2013, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii), dated the 27th May, 2013, except as respects things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the Central Government hereby establishes the National Board for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises for the purposes of the said Act, which shall consist of the following members, namely:- 1. Shri Kalraj Mishra, Union Minister, Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises 2. Shri Giriraj Singh, Minister of State, Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises 3. Minister in-charge of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, State of Manipur 4. Minister in-charge of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, State of Madhya Pradesh 5. Minister in-charge of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, State of Uttar Pradesh 6. Minister in-charge of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, State of Tamil Nadu 7. Minister in-charge of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, State of Maharashtra 8. Minister in-charge of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, State ofOdisha 9. Shri Rahul Kaswan, Member of Parliament (Lok Sabha) 10. Shri Nityanand Rai, Member of Parliament (Lok Sabha) 11. Shri B.K.Hari Prasad, Member of Parliament (Rajya Sabha) 12. Administrator (Lieutenant Governor) of Andaman and Nicobar 13. Secretary to the Government of India, Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises 14. Secretary to the Government of India, Ministry of Finance 15. Secretary to the Government ofIndia, Department ofIndustrial Policy and Promotion, Ministry of Commerce and Industry 16. Secretary to the Government of India, Ministry of Labour and Employment 17. Secretary to the Government of India, Ministry of Food Processing Industries 18. Chairman, National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development 19. Chairman, Small Industries Development Bank of India 20. Chairman, Indian Banks' Association 21. Deputy Governor, Reserve Bank of India' 22. National President, All India MSME Association (AlMA) 23. National President, Association of Small and Medium Knowledge Industries (AMSKI) 24. Chairman, MCC Chamber of Commerce and Industry, Kolkata 25. National General Secretary, Laghu Udyog Bharti 26. National President, All India Confederation of Small and Micro Industries Association. 27. Director General, India SME Forum, Mumbai 28. Chairman, Federation of Industries and Commerce of North East Region. 29. President, Tamil Nadu Small and Tiny Industries Association (TANSTIA) 30. Dalit India Chamber of Commerce and Industry (DICCI). 31.
